Here's the Iliad in emojis:

😤👑➡️😍👸 (Paris takes Helen)

🚢🚢🚢⚔️🏛️ (Greeks sail to Troy)

😷🔥😡👑 (Plague, Agamemnon angry)

🦁😤🚫⚔️ (Achilles refuses to fight)

👬💪⚔️☠️ (Patroclus fights and dies)

😭😡🦁➡️⚔️ (Achilles' rage, returns to battle)

🗡️👑☠️ (Achilles kills Hector)

🏃‍♂️🔄🏛️ (Drags body around Troy)

👴😢🙏💰 (Priam begs for body)

😢🤝⚱️ (Achilles returns body)

🔥⚱️😭 (Hector's funeral)
